<issue>
[BUG] S3 DeleteBucketReplication deletes the entire bucket
## Service

S3

## AWS API Action

DeleteBucketReplication

## Expected behavior

Real S3 `DELETE /{bucket}?replication` removes only the replication configuration and returns `204`. A sub-resource-qualified DELETE never deletes the bucket. `HeadBucket` afterward returns `200`.

## Actual behavior

`delete-bucket-replication` returns success, but the bucket itself is destroyed. The `?replication` sub-resource is not handled and falls through to the unqualified `DeleteBucket`. A subsequent `head-bucket` returns `404`:

```
An error occurred (404) when calling the HeadBucket operation: Not Found
```

## Reproduction

```bash
aws --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 s3api create-bucket --bucket repro-bucket
aws --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 s3api delete-bucket-replication --bucket repro-bucket
aws --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 s3api head-bucket --bucket repro-bucket
# => An error occurred (404) when calling the HeadBucket operation: Not Found
```

## Environment

- Floci version / image tag: 1.5.32
- Java SDK version (if applicable): n/a — AWS CLI 2.35.7
- How you're running Floci: Docker


</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find the S3 controller (Java) handling DELETE /{bucket} with sub-resources (e.g. ?tagging, ?cors, ?policy, ?lifecycle) and how replication GET/PUT is handled (if at all). Report file path, line numbers, and the code of the deleteBucket method and the sub-resource delete handlers, plus any replication-related code in the S3 service/model.

content.content: {"summary":"DELETE /{bucket} is handled in S3Controller.deleteBucket, which dispatches on query params (tagging, website, policy, cors, lifecycle, encryption, publicAccessBlock, ownershipControls) to S3Service delete methods and otherwise falls through to deleteBucket. Replication GET/PUT is not implemented: there is no ?replication branch in any S3 controller or service/model code, and no replication code in the S3 package.","findings":["S3Controller.java:279-320: deleteBucket(@PathParam bucket, @Context UriInfo). Checks hasQueryParam for tagging (285), website (289), policy (293), cors (297), lifecycle (301), encryption (305), publicAccessBlock (309), ownershipControls (313); each calls the matching s3Service method and returns 204. With no sub-resource it calls s3Service.deleteBucket(bucket) (317) and returns 204. AwsException is mapped via xmlErrorResponse (319-320).","S3Service.java:206-222 deleteBucket(String): ensureBucketExists, then listObjects(..., 1) and throws BucketNotEmpty 409 if any objects exist; then bucketStore.delete, removes in-memory data keys or deletes the data directory.","S3Service.java:1195-1201 deleteBucketWebsite: sets websiteConfiguration null and puts the bucket back; NoSuchBucket 404 if missing.","S3Service.java:1204-1211 deleteBucketTagging: sets tags to an empty HashMap.","S3Service.java:1578-1583 deleteBucketPolicy: sets policy null.","S3Service.java:1691-1696 deleteBucketCors: sets corsConfiguration null.","S3Service.java:1727-1733 deleteBucketLifecycle: sets lifecycleConfiguration null and transitionDefaultMinimumObjectSize null.","S3Service.java:1777-1782 deleteBucketEncryption: sets encryptionConfiguration null.","S3Service.java:1825-1830 deleteBucketOwnershipControls: sets ownershipControlsConfiguration null. The deletePublicAccessBlock method is called from the controller but its definition was not inspected.","Replication: a grep for 'replication' (case-insensitive) in src/main/java/.../services/s3/ returned no matches. S3Controller GET (around lines 363-402) and PUT (around lines 200-245) have no ?replication branch. PUT with no matching sub-resource falls through to createBucket (around line 265). Replication GET/PUT therefore falls through to the generic bucket handlers rather than returning a replication-specific response. The only 'replication' hits in src/main/java are ElastiCache replication groups, which are unrelated.","Test files reference deleteBucket (for example src/test/.../S3ServiceTest.java and S3IntegrationTest.java), but no replication tests exist under the S3 test packages."],"confidence":0.85}
